parties: Dotex Merchandise Private Limited; Spencer's Retail Limited
headline: Dotex Merchandise discloses substantial acquisition in Spencer's Retail under SEBI Takeover Code
sum: Dotex Merchandise Private Limited filed a Regulation 31(4) disclosure under the SEBI Takeover Regulations, signalling a substantial acquisition event in Spencer's Retail Limited; the exact stake, consideration and timing remain to be disclosed in subsequent filings.
detail: Dotex Merchandise Private Limited has submitted a formal disclosure to NSE under Regulation 31(4) of the SEBI (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations, 2011, indicating a trigger event in Spencer's Retail Limited. This disclosure is the first formal notification to the stock exchange of the intended or completed acquisition. Subsequent filings will detail the exact quantum of shares acquired, the consideration payable, and the timeline for the mandatory open offer. Spencer's Retail is a listed multi-format retail company and subsidiary of RP-Sanjiv Goenka group.
